title: Suprachoroidal injection of triamcinolone acetonide as adjuvant to surgical treatment of epiretinal membrane

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License)

condition: Idiopathic epiretinal membrane, Govetto stage 3-4, CRT above 300 um, pseudophakic patients aged 50-85; prospective randomized comparative pilot study (Brescia, Italy), 25-G pars plana vitrectomy with ERM and ILM peeling, intraoperative randomization 1:1 to intravitreal or suprachoroidal triamcinolone acetonide 4 mg

groups.agent: 25-G vitrectomy with ERM/ILM peeling plus intravitreal triamcinolone acetonide 4 mg (0.1 mL) at the end of surgery
groups.description: Group 1 (G-1), comparator arm; all 25 enrolled eyes completed 6 months

groups.agent: 25-G vitrectomy with ERM/ILM peeling plus suprachoroidal triamcinolone acetonide 4 mg (29 G needle, 0.9 mm exposed tip) at the end of surgery
groups.description: Group 2 (G-2), experimental arm; 25 enrolled, 23 analysed (2 missed the 6-month visit and were not analysed)

series.baseline_label: Baseline, before surgery (Table 2 row G-1 CRT, column 2)
series.notes: CRT by Spectralis HRA-OCT (radial or raster scan), no subfield definition; mean ± SD (Table 1 'Baseline CRT (SD)', same baseline); months after surgery; topical fluocinolone was given to some eyes with postoperative CME and two of them received a second suprachoroidal TA (Results); their values were not removed (all 25 eyes analysed)

series.baseline_label: Baseline, before surgery (Table 2 row G-2 CRT, column 2)
series.notes: CRT by Spectralis HRA-OCT (radial or raster scan), no subfield definition; mean ± SD (Table 1 'Baseline CRT (SD)', same baseline); months after surgery; analysis set is the 23 eyes that completed 6 months (2 enrolled eyes missed the 6-month visit); one eye received a second suprachoroidal TA for CME about 100 days after surgery and its values were not removed

exclusions.what: Table 2 rows R11, R15, R19 and Table 3 rows R4, R7 (p)

exclusions.reason: same eyes and baseline as Table 2 (duplicate); Table 2 cited

exclusions.what: Table 3 CRT reduction in um and percent
exclusions.reason: same eyes as the Table 2 absolute series (duplicate); the absolute series is used
ectopic inner foveal layer thickness is a layer thickness, not central retinal thickness

exclusions.what: Table 4 EIFL-T in Govetto stage 4 eyes
exclusions.reason: layer thickness, not central retinal thickness

exclusions.what: BCVA and IOP rows of Tables 1-2
exclusions.reason: visual acuity and IOP are not extracted
no tabulated central thickness at these visits

notes: Time origin: preoperative baseline; follow-up visits at 1, 3 and 6 months after surgery
Role: suprachoroidal TA is the experimental arm (treated); intravitreal TA is the comparator (control); both arms are vitrectomy plus triamcinolone and are coded as treatment 'combination'
Prior treatment for the epiretinal membrane is not stated in the Methods (all eyes pseudophakic, cataract surgery at least 3 months earlier)
